title: Book Two · Chapter 20: The Folded Page
story:
Leo is at his reading activity on Saturday morning. Ronan stands at the green gate with the blue animal book.

He looks down the street. Leo and his mother went that way earlier. Ronan did not go with them. Leo has one place in the group. Ronan has no place there today.

Mr Qiu clears a space on his table.

“Finished with my dogs?” he asks.

Ronan gives him the book.

“And the pig. The pig gets dirty again.”

“It usually does.”

Mr Qiu checks the cover. Ronan points to a small pale mark near the bottom.

“That was there at the start.”

“I know. Thank you. You kept it dry.”

He puts the old animal book in his side box. It is not on the shelf for sale.

A customer comes for a pencil. Ronan moves clear of the table. The customer needs a soft one. Mr Qiu shows her two pencils and lets her try one on a scrap.

Ronan waits beside the gate. He draws a little dog on his own scrap of paper. Its front legs look like the chair legs behind him.

Mrs Lan comes out with her shopping bag.

“Is that a dog or my chair?” she asks.

“A dog.”

“Then please don't sit on it.”

He laughs and gives the dog a tail.

Mum calls from the kitchen. She wants the small bottle of oil from her bag. Ronan carries it in. He walks slowly with the full bottle. Mum takes it and wipes a drop from the side.

“Thank you. Now leave room here for the bowls.”

Ronan goes back to the step. He has no book in his hands now. He puts his dog picture on the drawing board inside.

Later in the morning, Leo comes along the street with his mother. A white paper sticks out of his bag. He sees Ronan and comes to the green gate.

“Look.”

Leo opens the folded page.

It has three parts. On the front is a small bridge. Above the picture are the words THE SMALL BRIDGE. Inside there are short lines of story and another picture.

Ronan comes closer. Leo puts one hand over the paper to stop the breeze.

“Did you read all this?” Ronan asks.

“Some of it. The teacher read first. Then we took turns.”

“Were you first to finish?”

“No. A girl finished before me.”

Leo points to two lines of the story. He drew a mark under each line. One mark is a little crooked. He also put a circle around under.

Ronan looks at the circle and the small bridge. The paper is clean and bright. He wants a page like that, too. He does not tell Leo.

“Can I see inside?” he asks.

Leo opens the last part. There is no score and no prize picture. There are only words, two lines, and Leo's name.

His mother calls from the corner. They need to go home for lunch. Leo folds the page again and holds it against his chest.

“We can look another day,” he says.

Ronan nods. He lifts his hand to wave. Leo's paper disappears into the bag.

Mum puts rice into a bowl at home. Ronan sits beside her. He opens his mouth, then takes his spoon instead.

She gives him some vegetables. He moves his cloth away from the bowl. He folds it into three small parts and puts it by his cup.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

folded＝折起的；bridge＝桥；under＝在……下面；circle＝圆圈。

## 理解问题

1. Leo第一次读书活动后带回了什么？
2. Ronan归还了哪本书，他还没有说出口的愿望是什么？

## 读句子

**Leo / opens / the folded page.** Leo／打开／折页。
